figures.name: assay_key_candidates_and_controls
figures.title: Stored assay measurements and experimental variability
figures.caption:
All six stored measurements shown; black marker: stored mean. Axis is symlog near zero to retain zero readings.
Zeros are shown at zero. The CSV does not establish whether repeats are biological or technical. BL21 is the stored control label; empty-vector/no-enzyme identity is not inferred.

figures.name: current_metric_shortlist_recovery
figures.title: Shortlist recovery under current geometric and confidence baselines
figures.caption:
48 homologs; SfaB excluded from ranking. Groups are retrospective yield definitions, not validated active/inactive labels.
All compared metrics use the same saved one-Mg ensembles. Ties use expected recovery within a tied group. Earlier Gaussian-score results do not apply to A.

figures.name: all_explored_proxy_comparison
figures.title: Complete saved comparison of 14 structural descriptors
figures.caption:
Exploratory performance on a repeatedly inspected panel; n denotes defined enzyme-level scores. AUROC uses available scores.
Definitions and orientation are retained from the saved comparison; no direction was chosen using the plotted activity labels.

figures.name: activation_vs_aminolysis_readouts
figures.title: Activation and aminolysis geometry
figures.caption:
48 homologs; 50 poses per step. N–C distance is the harmonic mean for the neutral amine and activated acyl carbon.
Paired saved one-Mg predictions. Neutral attacking N assigned by ligand formal charge and topology. Aminolysis distance does not reproduce activation-step enrichment in this panel. Step 2 uses pocket-localization restraints. Distance alone is not an attack-orientation or catalytic-barrier measurement.

figures.name: complete_mutant_geometry_tradeoffs
figures.title: Full saturation scan: angular gains and distance changes
figures.caption:
ΔA: weighted angle; ΔdH: harmonic O–P distance. Each substitution is compared with its matched WT.
5,586 single substitutions + 3 matched WT controls; 50 predictions each; separate two-Mg campaign. Changes are predicted geometry, not measured activity. Lower-right quadrant combines higher A and shorter dH.

figures.name: structural_proxy_search_inventory
figures.title: Structural descriptors explored
figures.caption: Historical inventory: 88 distinct nonconstant definitions grouped by physical quantity. Counts include formula / threshold variants and sampling diagnostics, not independent hypotheses.

scope: Saved-data plots and explicit mathematical illustrations only; no new predictor or fleet execution.
